test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is.

Option 1) NR - TA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a10611e057841fbbfb2750553046956a8547d4ea342136592c83d5e831a7b63c.png] 

Option 2) RV - XE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/316c8f13705ac08cf701e4c7ee1d93f80fc97f7130b365207d596506c031649d.png] 

Option 3) DH - IQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40005e2d5293d0eca83a180d12563405b2581c35999147f8a5899b41a7779587.png] 

Option 4) XB - DK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c4a1e7092af5297c58c1660e1ac6d579fdf05232568755c107c7817c3300392.png] 

Thus, out of all 'DH - IQ' is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
